availableVersions.label: v3.6.0 (Post-Audit Remediation)
availableVersions.description: Comprehensive post-audit remediation release addressing Dr. Aniruddha Ghosh's external critical review, implementing the consecutive-season sequence view (Figure 3.1B), aligning official KNBS census baselines, and eliminating pseudo-statutory language.
highlights: Executive County Brief & 2-Page Print/PDF Export: 1-screen actionable synthesis in Section 0 with live planetary drivers (RONI/DMI), statutory KMSA advisory mandate, analogue consensus odds with Wilson 95% confidence intervals, top 3 historical precedents, and 4-sector anticipatory action matrix formatted strictly for 2-page print export (Decision D55).
Figure 3.1B Consecutive-Season Sequence View: pairs OND(Y−1) → MAM(Y) to track dual-season failure trajectories and unbroken pasture deficit runs (Decision D53).
Comprehensive External Audit Remediation: resolved all 15 identified code/data defects and sanitized 126 factual claims from Dr. Aniruddha Ghosh's review.
Official KNBS Census Benchmarks: aligned population exposure to 2019 Census enumerated headcounts and 2026 projections across all 47 counties (Decision D51).
NOAA CPC JAS 2026 Teleconnection Ingestion: verified live RONI (+1.69 °C) and aligned metric spaces for analogue matching (Decision D42).
Empirical Non-Parametric Climatological Quantiles: replaced Gaussian bands with 1991–2020 WMO empirical quantiles (P10, P33, P67, P90) in Figure 3.1 (Decision D43).
Figure 4.2B Crop & Climate Historical Response: integrated HarvestStat maize/beans time series (1990–2024) and seasonal rainfall terciles (Decision D40).

categories.title: New Features & Visualizations
items: Executive County Brief & Citable 2-Page Print/PDF Export: Comprehensive 1-screen briefing document directly addressing County CIDP officers, climate-finance proposal writers (GCF/AF), and County Disaster Risk Management Committees (CDRMC). Features responsive diagnostic KPI cards, top 3 verified historical analogue precedents, multi-sector anticipatory action matrix, 1-click citable proposal text copying, and print stylesheet formatted strictly for 2-page A4 output (Decision D55).

Figure 3.1B Consecutive Seasonal Sequences & Compounding Runs: Resolves Decision D39's additive half; pairs production years Y = OND(Y−1) + MAM(Y) per official KNBS/HarvestStat conventions, displays 2-cell domino strips with continuous diverging z colormaps, tracks unbroken sub-normal runs, highlights double-failure emergencies (2011, 2017, 2008, etc.), and correlates with staple crop yield deficits.

Figure 4.2B Long-Term Crop & Climate Historical Response: Integrates HarvestStat county maize and bean production/yield (1990–2024), 2002–2014 seasonal reporting gap overlays, and CHIRPS planting-season tercile strips (Decision D40).
Figure 1.1 Responsive Side-by-Side Commodity Panels: Dynamic multi-panel layout rendering Crop and Livestock balances side-by-side without vertical clipping or overflow (Decision D48).
In-Fold Metadata Drawer Navigation: In-place slide-out metadata drawer on the active tab, eliminating jarring full-page jumps to Tab 6 (Decision D49).
Figure 4.1 Headroom & Unified Legend: Consolidated Panel A and Panel B headings and legends into a single unified bar, providing ample headroom preventing text label clipping (Decision D50).

categories.title: Data Ingestion & Demographic Benchmarks
items: Tier 16 Exposure Denominators & Demographic Re-Leveling: Actioned upstream pipeline dispatch re-pulling exposure parquets; aligned Section 1 demographics to official KNBS 2019 Census enumerated headcount and 2026 projections across all 47 counties (Decision D51).
Official Sub-County Universe: Labeled adm2 boundaries as official IEBC parliamentary constituencies (290 units), documenting boundary universe divergence from KNBS's 345 administrative sub-counties.
NOAA CPC JAS 2026 Ocean Drivers: Verified real-time NOAA CPC ingestion (+1.69 °C RONI, +2.56 °C Niño 3.4), replacing stale lead-ins and updating drivers parquets with 30/30 freshness assertions.
GESI Vulnerability Database: Ingested 35 verified KNBS 2019/2023 indicators across 4 thematic domains with dynamic reactive county loading, eliminating hardcoded Marsabit fallbacks (Decision D46).
EC JRC Global River Flood Hazard Maps v2.1: Replaced placeholder GloFAS mentions with authoritative 90 m 2D LISFLOOD-FP flood hazard maps (10–500 year return periods; Baugh et al. 2024).

categories.title: Science, Teleconnections & Methodology
items: Empirical Non-Parametric Rainfall Quantiles: Replaced parametric Gaussian normal bands with empirical P10, P33, P67, P90 quantiles from 1991–2020 WMO baseline, eliminating negative rainfall thresholds (Decision D43).

Unified Metric Space for Analogue Matching: Mapped IRI Niño 3.4 plume median into RONI space before Euclidean distance calculation against historical OND RONI, eliminating inflated anomaly alerts (Decision D42).
Unbiased Analogue Mode Classification: Implemented explicit tie detection (TIED MODE) when analogue seasons are evenly split across terciles (Defect 8).
Dual-Window Ocean Driver Formulation: Documented Pacific vs Indian Ocean empirical baseline standard deviations, clarifying variance ratios govern SST, not rainfall (Decision D44).
Western-V Gradient Clarification: Aligned MAM Western-V gradient definition with Funk et al. (2019, 2023) and replaced 'persistent' droughts with 'more frequent' droughts.

categories.title: Institutional Alignment & Governance
items: Institutional Realignment: Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (KMSA) under Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026; County Disaster Risk Management Committees (CDRMC) under NDRM Act 2026; expanded NDMA warning stages to all 6 operational phases.

Tone & Authority Sanitization: Removed pseudo-statutory language ('Anti-AI Slop', 'statutory legal baselines', 'audited statutory indicators') and internal developer ticket codes (Decisions D44, D52).

Verified Literature Citations: Replaced defective/hallucinated academic citations with verified Crossref DOIs (Bauer-Marschallinger 2022, Wagner 2026, Funk 2019/2023 Western-V, Gamoyo 2015 rewritten).
Operational Tool Links: Converted Table 2.3 into active hyperlinks pointing to live KMSA, NDMA, KRCS, ICPAC, KFSSG, and NDOC portals.

categories.title: Audit Remediations & Bug Fixes
items: Defect 1: ENSO state gauge sorted chronologically (DJF..NDJ), showing active JAS 2026 (+1.69 °C) instead of jumping to past seasons.
Defect 3 & 4: Removed silent hardcoded fallback constants and synthetic z=0 scoring in analogue ranking.
Defect 10: CCSR/IRI prediction plume ensemble average traces segregated from individual models, ensuring clean median computation.
Review Tools Gated: Floating annotation tools and review dashboard hidden behind ?review=true in production.

availableVersions.label: v3.5.2 (Dr. Ghosh Audit Baseline)
availableVersions.description: Baseline edition audited by Dr. Aniruddha Ghosh (Senior Scientist / Spatial Modeler, Alliance Bioversity-CIAT / CGIAR) on 5 Oct 2026.
highlights: Served as the reference baseline for the comprehensive external expert critical review.
Introduced Section 3 Sub-County Comparison tool and Section 4 Pastoral Terms of Trade.
Included in-situ partner review annotation tools and floating feedback drawers.

categories.title: Features Introduced
items: Section 3 Sub-County Comparison Tool: Interactive comparison of bimodal rainfall regimes and seasonal totals across sub-counties.
Section 4 Pastoral Terms of Trade: Analysis of goat-to-maize terms of trade across ASAL pastoral counties.
Section 5 Historical Multi-Hazard Timeline: Multi-decade view of drought, flood, and food crisis occurrences in Kenya.
In-Situ Partner Feedback Tooling: Floating review widgets, area screenshot tool, and local storage feedback exporter.

categories.title: Known Audit Baseline Limitations
items: 15 identified code and data defects audited in Dr. Ghosh's review (including unsorted ENSO gauge and stale RONI lead-in).
Mismatched literature citations and DOIs.
Exposed development review tools without query parameter gating.

availableVersions.label: v2.10 (August 2026 Milestone)
availableVersions.description: August milestone review edition with initial analogue ranking, historical climate trends, and baseline agricultural production statistics.
highlights: Initial analogue ranking engine based on OND Niño 3.4 and DMI distance matching.
Section 1 County Context profile with basic population and agricultural statistics.
Section 3 Historical Climate trends with CHIRPS seasonal rainfall bars.
Section 4 Agricultural Impact analysis with preliminary KNBS NAPR production time series.

categories.title: Key Capabilities
items: Historical Analogue Engine v1: Euclidean distance matching against historical El Niño/La Niña seasons.
County Context Profiles: Basic demographic, area, and agricultural production summaries for all 47 counties.
CHIRPS v2.0 Seasonal Rainfall: Basic OND and MAM seasonal rainfall bar charts.

availableVersions.label: v1.0 (Initial Prototype)
availableVersions.description: Initial exploratory baseline prototype demonstrating bimodal rainfall regimes and preliminary ENSO teleconnection correlations.
highlights: Demonstrated OND Short Rains teleconnection to Pacific ENSO.
Established DuckDB-WASM browser-side parquet query architecture.

categories.title: Key Capabilities
items: DuckDB-WASM Client-Side Architecture: Validated zero-backend serverless querying of Parquet files directly in the browser.
Basic ENSO Teleconnection Plots: Exploratory scatter plots linking seasonal rainfall to Niño 3.4 indices.
